sources.snippet: What is OnnxTR OnnxTR is an ONNX wrapper around the docTR library that provides high-performance OCR capabilities without requiring PyTorch or TensorFlow dependencies. The system converts document images and PDFs into structured, machine-readable text by locating text regions (detection) and recognizing the characters within them (recognition).
